title: Discovery of anti-hepatoma agents from 1,4,5,6,7,8-hexahydropyrido[4,3-d]pyrimidine by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway activation.
authors: Zhou, Yan-Qiu; Sun, Yue; Luo, Han-Lin; Gao, Zhong-Fei; Zhang, Hong-Qin; Meng, Qing-Guo; Bai, Xian-Yong; Hou, Gui-Ge; Hou, Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文为抗肝癌小分子化合物的合成与活性研究，涉及PI3K/AKT/NF-kB通路抑制和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: In order to obtain new anti-hepatoma drugs with low toxicity, some 1,4,5,6,7,8-hexahydropyrido[4,3-d]pyrimidines (PPMs, 4a-t) were synthesized in this study. Many of them showed significant anti-hepatoma effects against HCC cells and low toxicity toward HHL-5 cells. Combined with their anti-hepatoma activity and toxicity, 4-CF(3)-substituted 4k was selected as an effective lead compound. Preliminary mechanistic studies revealed that 4k could up-regulate the expression levels of Bax and caspase-3 proteins, down-regulate the expression levels of Bcl-2 protein, promote significant apoptosis of HepG2, and block cells in G2-M phase to prevent cells from completing mitosis. Also, 4k could significantly inhibit the activation of PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway by blocking the phosphorylation of PI3K, AKT, NF-kappaB/p65 and IFN-gamma-induced nuclear transport. Docking analysis showed that 4k could reasonably bind to the active sites of Bcl-2, NF-kappaB/p65, PI3K and AKT. This result suggested that 4k could be used as a new type of NF-kappaB inhibitor, which provides a scientific basis for further research into the treatment of hepatoma.
abstract_zh: 为获得低毒性的新型抗肝癌药物，本研究合成了一些1,4,5,6,7,8-六氢吡啶并[4,3-d]嘧啶类化合物（PPMs, 4a-t）。其中许多化合物对HCC细胞表现出显著的抗肝癌效果，且对HHL-5细胞毒性较低。结合其抗肝癌活性和毒性，4-CF(3)取代的4k被选为有效的先导化合物。初步机制研究表明，4k能上调Bax和caspase-3蛋白的表达水平，下调Bcl-2蛋白的表达水平，促进HepG2细胞显著凋亡，并将细胞阻滞在G2-M期，阻止细胞完成有丝分裂。此外，4k通过阻断PI3K、AKT、NF-kappaB/p65的磷酸化及IFN-γ诱导的核转运，显著抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路的激活。对接分析显示，4k能合理结合至Bcl-2、NF-kappaB/p65、PI3K和AKT的活性位点。这一结果表明，4k可作为新型NF-kappaB抑制剂，为肝癌治疗的进一步研究提供了科学依据。
